requirements.summary: Apply “Sabji wala” branding across the frontend UI and browser/tab title, keeping all user-facing text in English.
acceptanceCriteria: The main page prominently displays the app name “Sabji wala”.
No user-facing text is introduced in non-English languages.

file_operations.description: Ensure the base HTML document title is set to “Sabji wala” so the browser/tab title is correct on initial load.
Create the root App component that renders the landing page and sets the runtime document title to “Sabji wala” for consistent branding across navigations/renders.

Create a header component that prominently displays the “Sabji wala” brand name and uses English-only navigation/CTA text (no commerce flows). Use shadcn-ui components for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Build a polished, simple landing page layout (header + hero + at least one informational section) for a fresh-produce concept without commerce features.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page has a header and hero section with the “Sabji wala” name.
Page includes at least one additional section (e.g., “How it works”, “Why choose us”, or “Freshness promise”) using English copy.
No cart, checkout, payment, or ordering workflow is implemented.

file_operations.description: Create the landing page UI with a clear layout: header, hero section (brand + tagline + optional non-commerce CTA), and at least one informational section (e.g., Freshness Promise / How it works) using English copy only. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button/Badge) for polished layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the LandingPage into the app so it is rendered as the main screen (no additional routes/pages unless already present).

requirements.summary: Define and apply a cohesive non-blue/non-purple visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, component styling) consistently across the landing page.
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent theme is applied (color palette, typography, and spacing).
UI looks intentionally designed rather than unstyled defaults.

file_operations.description: Add global theme styles using Tailwind + CSS variables consistent with shadcn composition (e.g., warm produce palette with greens/oranges, not blue/purple). Establish typography/spacing defaults and background/foreground colors used across the landing page.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions as needed to support the chosen produce brand look (e.g., custom brand color tokens/shadows) while keeping primary colors non-blue/non-purple.

Apply the theme consistently across sections (spacing scale, typography hierarchy, buttons/cards styling) using Tailwind utilities and shadcn-ui composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fetch the app name from the backend and render it on the landing page with a sensible loading state to confirm integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method returning app info that includes the name “Sabji wala”.
Frontend calls the backend and renders the returned name on the page.
The page still renders with a sensible loading state while fetching.

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook that uses the existing useActor hook to call the backend capability getAppName() and returns {data,isLoading,isError} for UI consumption (no authentication required).

Wire the useAppName hook into the header/hero area to display the returned app name and show a sensible loading placeholder while fetching. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Skeleton/Badge) if available for loading state; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add required generated images as static assets and display them on the landing page (logo + hero illustration) without using the backend for images.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are stored in frontend/public/assets/generated.
Landing page displays the logo and hero illustration from these static paths.
No backend code is used to host or proxy these images.

file_operations.description: Add the generated logo asset as a static file at frontend/public/assets/generated/sabji-wala-logo.dim_512x512.png.
Add the generated hero illustration asset as a static file at frontend/public/assets/generated/sabji-wala-hero.dim_1600x900.png.
Render the logo image from frontend/public/assets/generated/sabji-wala-logo.dim_512x512.png in the header, aligned with the “Sabji wala” brand.

Render the hero illustration from frontend/public/assets/generated/sabji-wala-hero.dim_1600x900.png in the hero section and ensure it’s responsive and matches the theme (static asset only; no backend image serving).
